posts.cooked:
As you may have heard, Handelabra Games is working on a native Android version of Sentinels Sidekick. We are at the point where we are looking for alpha/beta testers to try it out and provide feedback.

Testers should have both an Android tablet and an Android phone; the more devices the merrier. Your role will be to install and use the beta builds of the app and provide feedback on problems, suggestions, general reaction, etc.

All beta testers that participate and provide feedback will receive a free copy of the final app upon release.

To sign up: just post a reply here. Please include what Android devices you own, along with operating system versions.

We will go through the responses and send invitations within a few days. Thanks!

I only have a phone, not a tablet.  It is an LG Optimus G LG-LS970.  I don't have a Google account assigned to it.  It is currently running Android 4.1.2, under Linux kernel 3.4.0.  I am seriously considering installing either CyanogenMod, or possibly Jolla (which has a double Android compatibility layer).  It also has Google Services Framework disabled, because it kept giving me a notification about a system update which would never successfully install, and I wanted to get rid of the annoying notification for this update.  I think disabling this has prevented me from receiving push notifications for the RTV6 app I have installed.  I also have Unknown Sources allowed, as without a Google account assigned, I would be otherwise unable to install apps.

That said, I would still be interested, assuming I qualify.

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: I doubt they can interact using the new built in iOS feature allowing communications between iOS devices.  However, there is a protocol known as AllJoyn which is supposed to allow computers and devices communicate with each other, reguardless of the operating system running (so long as the AllJoyn framework has been ported to that operating system), and without need for an internet connection (such as bluetooth or WiFi Direct or whatever).
